headline: Fear fell and Nifty rose, yet *FIIs still sold*
subline: India VIX fell to 15.12. DIIs bought Rs 1,924.41 Cr as FIIs sold.
hero_text: India VIX fell 6.94% to 15.12 as Nifty rose 1.05%. FIIs sold Rs 943.6 Cr in cash while DIIs bought Rs 1,924.41 Cr.

why.title: Financials led the lift
why.desc: Nifty Financial Services rose 1.17% on a broad bank bid.

why.title: FMCG ran a defensive bid
why.desc: The FMCG index jumped 2.34%, among the day's top sectors.

why.title: Global cues stayed mixed
why.desc: Wall Street slipped while Europe rose.

why.title: The fear gauge cooled off
why.desc: India VIX fell 6.94% as nerves eased.

sector_reasons.Realty: Topped the board with a broad bid
sector_reasons.FMCG: Staples ran on a strong defensive bid
sector_reasons.PSU Bank: Rode the wider bank rally higher
sector_reasons.Auto: Only red sector as Maruti and Bajaj Auto slipped
sector_reasons.Oil & Gas: Gained, but trailed the wider rally
sector_reasons.Healthcare: Rose quietly, behind the main tape

bonus_text: FIIs sold Rs 943.6 Cr in cash. DIIs bought Rs 1,924.41 Cr, about twice that outflow.
movers_note_gainers: Adani Ports and Adani Enterprises led, with Kotak Bank next.
movers_note_losers: Trent fell most. Maruti and Bajaj Auto joined the auto drag.
watch_text: Nifty OI walls sit at 22,000 and 23,500. The BOJ rate decision lands at 12:00 IST on Friday.
lessons: Staples and banks rose together. The bid was not a simple rotation.
Breadth backed the index. About 5 stocks rose for every 3 that fell.
Fear drained while the world was mixed. Wall Street slipped, Europe rose, and the VIX still dropped.
Autos were the lone red sector, a small hole in a broad rally.
alert_text: The BOJ policy rate decision is due at 12:00 IST on Friday. German CPI and GDP follow.
cta_headline: A calm rally. *Bookmark the flows split*.
cta_sub: Friday opens with the BOJ decision at 12:00 IST.
next_text: Friday 30 October brings the BOJ decision at 12:00 IST. German CPI and GDP follow in the evening.
caption_a:
India VIX fell 6.94% to 15.12 while FIIs still sold Rs 943.6 Cr.
Nifty rose 1.05% to 22,936.75. FMCG led with 2.34%.
DIIs bought Rs 1,924.41 Cr and more than offset the selling.
Watch: the BOJ rate decision at 12:00 IST on Friday.
